faqs.q: How late can a band play in Boulder?
faqs.a: As late as your venue's own rules allow, and Boulder venues and neighborhoods set earlier limits than Denver's. Give us the cap and the cut-off at contract, and both go into the plan, including how the last set lands on the cut-off. Signet Artists books private-party musicians in Boulder from Denver.

faqs.q: Does travel from Denver add to a Boulder quote?
faqs.a: One short line on the quote, covering the whole trip there and back. There's no mileage arithmetic and no lodging line, because the band drives home from Boulder, and the fee for the music itself is the same one a Denver host sees.

faqs.q: Can music play outside at a Boulder home?
faqs.a: Yes, at dinner volume, on a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it. Colorado evenings cool fast, so the music comes indoors as the night does.

faqs.q: What does a Boulder booking need for setup and parking?
faqs.a: One van, 45 to 60 minutes of setup through whichever door the venue prefers, and for a solo, about 6 by 4 feet with one dedicated circuit. Parking is the Boulder question worth settling early: downtown is metered, Chautauqua shares its lot with a trailhead that fills on summer evenings, and a house on the Hill shares its curb with students during the university year. Tell us the address and we plan the carry.
Most any time, except November and December, which run on the corporate season's clock, decided August through October. New Year's Eve books first.
